div.div:
Notation
folder = package (nested folder = sub-package)
box = class; «interface», «static» = stereotypes; italic = namespace or folder
dashed open arrow = «uses» dependency (unlabelled ones too)
dashed hollow triangle = realization (class → interface)
solid open arrow = association (role and multiplicity)
